contrary_evidence: Both euro- and dollar-denominated cross-border bank credit grew 11% year on year; euro share growth is not dollar exit.
ICI attributes the 14 October domestic-equity withdrawal primarily to collective investment trusts rather than individual redemptions.
The 21 October combined ICI estimate returned to positive territory and cannot prove where the earlier institutional assets went.
Money-market asset changes cover a different week and population from long-term combined fund flows.
BEA Q2 external balance changes were dominated by market valuation rather than new transactions.
UNCTAD M&A deal value increased while deal counts and greenfield announcements declined.
limitations: Full repository-wide strict editorial-depth CI failed for five previously rejected or legacy staged items, not for this candidate; this candidate passed all observed deterministic candidate thresholds.
Original source checks were performed on the main quantitative releases and other cited official material; complete PDF-level examination of every one of the 14 documents was not performed.
Cross-border bank-credit aggregates, investment-fund vehicle flows, reserve shares and announced investment do not identify ultimate beneficial ownership or final project deployment.
Approval is limited to the exact three Git blobs; no public publication or deployment is implied.
notes: Independent QA of MT-WF-2026-11-02 revision 0 (revision omitted in pending, interpreted as zero by repository validators). All candidate-specific editorial and visual checks passed. No reports/**, indexes, taxonomy, CSS or institutional content modified.
